note: One card per dynamic. Cards with a walkthrough step through it; the rest name what the dynamic needs.

cards.title: Round-robin rolling hotspot
cards.summary: Equal request counts, wildly unequal work. The hotspot walks the fleet and the tail latency follows it.
cards.requires: request-level arrivals, replica queues, size heterogeneity. No LLM detail; decode off.

cards.title: Stale-telemetry oscillation
cards.summary: Least-loaded routing on a delayed snapshot. Every router picks the same idle replica and the load sloshes.
cards.requires: telemetry delay model, perturbation input, frequency sweep.

cards.title: Herding gets worse as the fleet grows
cards.summary: The same least_requests policy at the same 250 ms telemetry and the same offered/capacity ratio: fine at 32 replicas, collapsed at 256. The herd scales with the fleet.
cards.requires: least_requests, telemetry cadence, a fleet-size sweep at fixed offered/capacity ratio

cards.title: Prefill and decode interference
cards.summary: Raising the step budget buys time-to-first-token and spends inter-token latency for everyone already decoding.
cards.requires: chunked prefill, mixed step budget, epoch cost model.

cards.title: KV preemption spiral at low load
cards.summary: A fleet inside its request-rate capacity collapsing anyway, because contexts and not requests are what fill the cache.
cards.requires: KV accounting, preemption with recompute or swap, sessions.

cards.title: Retry storms and metastable collapse
cards.summary: A slowdown becomes an outage that does not clear when load returns to normal.
cards.requires: client timeout and retry, retry budget, circuit breaker.

cards.title: Traffic shaping at every layer
cards.summary: Where admission control belongs, and what it costs to shed late instead of early.
cards.requires: admission control at client, gateway, router and replica; token-based limits.

cards.title: Mixed latency SLO classes
cards.summary: Batch traffic exists to be preempted. Per-class goodput says whether that is actually happening.
cards.requires: priority queues, deadline awareness, per-class goodput.

cards.title: Past the knee, more load is less work
cards.summary: Goodput peaks well below rated capacity; throughput peaks later; past both, offering more load delivers less of everything.
cards.requires: power-of-two-choices routing, an offered-rate sweep.

cards.title: Capacity is a token budget
cards.summary: A load-balancer metric can improve while service collapses, because token cost and request count measure different things.
cards.requires: long-context workload share, token-denominated capacity accounting.

cards.title: disable_decode: the routing ordering still holds
cards.summary: Zero the HBM bandwidth term and KV still binds in tokens. p2c still beats round robin by the same shape of margin.
cards.requires: disable_decode scenario key, demo 7.

cards.title: least_kv_probe: live KV instead of a stale scrape
cards.summary: Probing a replica's resident KV tokens directly bounds imbalance the way finding 2's sampling does, at the cost of a modelled RPC.
cards.requires: live KV probe routing policy, demo 8.

cards.title: deadline_aware: shed on expected wait
cards.summary: Admission control that estimates queue wait ahead of time and sheds before device time is spent, not after.
cards.requires: deadline-aware admission policy, demo 9.

cards.title: fair_share: shedding the tenant actually over its share
cards.summary: Windowed per-tenant token accounting sheds specifically the over-share tenant, and fleet goodput rises for everyone else.
cards.requires: windowed per-tenant admission policy, demo 10.

cards.title: Prefix affinity against load spreading
cards.summary: The cache-hit rate and the balance are in direct tension, and one knob sets the trade.
cards.requires: prefix topology at Ingress and the prefix_affinity policy (U27a/U27b); the hit rate on the wire lands with U27c.

cards.title: Affinity hotspot failover cascade
cards.summary: Losing a replica moves its prefixes somewhere cold, and the cold cost arrives all at once.
cards.requires: dynamic 8 plus failure injection plus cold-cache cost.

cards.title: Gray failure and detection latency
cards.summary: A replica serving at a quarter speed while announcing healthy. Detection latency is the policy property under test.
cards.requires: health vector, detection policies, ejection.

cards.title: Global cascading failure
cards.summary: Retries plus gray failure plus a shared dependency, across clusters.
cards.requires: dynamics 5 and 10 plus multi-cluster plus shared dependencies.

cards.title: Multi-geo diurnal autoscaling
cards.summary: A cold start of 30 to 300 seconds against a burst that develops in tens of seconds.
cards.requires: multi-cluster, geo routing, turn-up delay, warm pools, predictive scaling.

cards.title: KV memory tiering, DRAM and SSD
cards.summary: Swap beats recompute until the shared path saturates, and then it does not.
cards.requires: tier pools with shared bandwidth, migration policies.

cards.title: Prefill and decode disaggregation
cards.summary: Two pools, a modelled fabric between them, and two sizing problems instead of one.
cards.requires: separate pools, KV transfer over modelled fabric, dual sizing.

cards.title: Speculative decoding value and cost
cards.summary: N=4 drafts more than double small-batch throughput, then the verify cost overtakes the win by batch 144 and the fleet's rated capacity barely moves at all.
cards.requires: sub-epoch acceptance sampling, batch-dependent acceptance rate, demo 12.

cards.title: Model weight locality and MoE
cards.summary: Weights as tiered objects, and a cache replacement problem above the KV one.
cards.requires: weights as tiered objects, weight cache replacement.
